verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards. Its Agent Skills teach assistants to generate queries over traces, logs and metrics, write ClickHouse queries, and create dashboards from natural language. However, all of this runs through an external AI client rather than a native in-product natural-language query box. Missing for 10: an in-app natural-language query or chart experience, detailed evidence of the queries and charts actually produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
